q: Two Packet System of tendering is provided in which clause of GCC?
The main object of the Two Packet System is:

options.A: To assess tenders technically without being influenced by financial bids

e: The correct answer is To assess tenders technically without influence of financial bids. A tender is a formal offer to supply/execute at quoted rates; railways invite open tenders to ensure competition and transparency. Remember: Make a one-line note of this concept for revision; it recurs in several papers. If two options look similar, the difference is usually one precise technical word. Remember the underlying principle, not just the sentence: examiners often rephrase the same concept.
